query: Which health-economic method (microcosting vs modeled costs), outcome utilities, and ROI/break-even thresholds will persuade hospital administrators and payors to adopt corrective actions?

response.query: Which health-economic method (microcosting vs modeled costs), outcome utilities, and ROI/break-even thresholds will persuade hospital administrators and payors to adopt corrective actions?
response.answer: Microcosting, high-value outcome utilities, and clear ROI/break-even thresholds will persuade hospital administrators and payors to adopt corrective actions. Cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA) and modeled costs often provide the necessary evidence.
